_comment: The labelling node of this instance's skills/ (#980: nesting is described FROM WITHIN). Two lists, one node: `topics` names subdirectories that hold skill PACKAGES (bean 9umr, read by scripts/skill-topics.ts); `directories` names INSTANCE directories declared inside skills/ (bean cmsl, owner 2026-09-30, round 4), resolved exactly as if <instance>.json declared them, which it did until this change. Paths are relative to this file's directory.

directories.description: THE WHO STYLE GUIDE: three `folio-voice-skill/v1` voice skills, one per WHO publication in this instance's own library, each a directory holding `voice.json` (the RULES, every one carrying the quote it was read from and a citation naming `{ libraryId, sectionId }`) and `SKILL.md` (how to USE them in authoring, review and QA). Under `skills/` because a voice IS a skill: it tells an actor what to do and is bound to processes by name. A voice is DERIVED FROM a publication and is not the publication, so these live beside the library rather than inside it, citing it in the bare same-instance form. `bun run cat check:voices` resolves each citation.
